what_happened.line: The Planning Board continued the Water District office and garage hearing at 496 Massachusetts Avenue to May 8, 2017.
Before continuing, the board voted waivers on plan scale, photometric plan, traffic and community impact analysis, and the vertical datum requirement.
The board closed the hearing on a temporary recreational marijuana moratorium and voted to recommend it favorably.
The applicant is to return revisions to the board the Monday before May 8; a recodification hearing is set for May 1.
A resident objected to abandoning town buildings and moving town offices to TC Passios, and asked that offices stay in the town center.

why_it_matters: The Water District project is a new office and garage site that still needs board approval, and the waivers narrow what the applicant must submit.
The moratorium recommendation goes on to a town vote, where residents will be asked whether to pause recreational marijuana businesses for a temporary period.
Where town offices end up, whether in existing buildings or at TC Passios, affects how residents reach town services and what happens to the older buildings.
watch_next: May 1, 2017: recodification hearing.
May 8, 2017: continued Water District hearing, with applicant revisions due the Monday before.
